name: doc-pii-guard
description: Privacy-preserving PII masking for spreadsheets (.xlsx/.csv) and Word (.docx/.doc): reversibly tokenizes names, ID numbers, phones, bank cards, and emails with strict hook guards while keeping full spreadsheet editing, analysis, joins, and local auto-restoration.
